inventory_status: Initial requirements inventory; not exhaustive and not implementation evidence.

capabilities.name: workspace-lifecycle
capabilities.target_scope: Local CLI and embedded workspace initialization, ownership, shutdown and restart
limitations: Trusted single-user workspace; multiple service owners rejected.

capabilities.name: native-only-execution
capabilities.target_scope: Base golden workflow without Java, Spark, Docker or remote compute
limitations: Must be proven from a clean installation and process/network evidence.
Personal Databricks reference probes are separate development tooling; routine tests and BrickHouse execution must not contact the account or consume its credentials.

capabilities.name: offline-operation
capabilities.target_scope: Provisioned dependencies and local artifacts run without external network
limitations: Offline installation and optional artifact provisioning are separate concerns.
Reviewed Databricks fixtures must be consumable locally with no personal credentials; live reference refresh is outside offline/runtime gates.

capabilities.name: namespaces
capabilities.target_scope: SDK catalogs/schemas, identifier binding and persistence
limitations: Initial API subset and quoted/case behavior must be enumerated.

capabilities.name: managed-tables
capabilities.target_scope: Real Delta managed table identities, locations and ownership
limitations: No separate DuckDB physical managed-table copy.

capabilities.name: external-tables
capabilities.target_scope: Register and access external Delta with non-destructive metadata drop
limitations: Only verified locations/protocol features; external file ownership preserved.

capabilities.name: session-state
capabilities.target_scope: Independent namespaces, temp views, configuration and UDF registration
limitations: No assumption that all Sparkless session state is already isolated.

capabilities.name: basic-writes
capabilities.target_scope: Create, append and overwrite through common table service
limitations: Initial type/protocol envelope selected by B004.

capabilities.name: mutations
capabilities.target_scope: Update, delete and merge with committed version/metrics
limitations: Provider support and SQL expression semantics need separate evidence.

capabilities.name: schema-and-partitions
capabilities.target_scope: Selected schema evolution and partitioned-table behavior
limitations: Expand after initial unpartitioned envelope; no blanket feature support.

capabilities.name: history-time-travel
capabilities.target_scope: History and version/timestamp snapshot selection
limitations: Snapshot/retention and cross-engine fidelity must be specified.

capabilities.name: maintenance
capabilities.target_scope: Selected optimize/compaction/Z-order/vacuum behavior
limitations: Native provider capability alone is not Databricks API compatibility.

capabilities.name: advanced-features
capabilities.target_scope: Column mapping, deletion vectors, CDF and other table features
limitations: Detect and reject unsupported features before execution; separate each feature during decomposition.

capabilities.name: commit-recovery
capabilities.target_scope: Durable mutation journal, idempotency and uncertain outcome handling
limitations: Exactly-once claim limited to proven operation/provider combinations.

capabilities.name: sparkless-dataframes
capabilities.target_scope: Sparkless DataFrames bound to authoritative catalog and writes
limitations: Coverage inherited only after integration fixtures pass.

capabilities.name: typed-interchange
capabilities.target_scope: Arrow/staged typed interchange preserving supported nested and scalar types
limitations: Bounded memory and metadata fidelity require tests.

capabilities.name: statement-execution
capabilities.target_scope: SDK Statement API lifecycle, parameters, bounded JSON results and cancellation
limitations: Formats/chunks/metadata require explicit implementation.

capabilities.name: spark-semantics
capabilities.target_scope: Versioned query/DDL/mutation corpus using explicit routing
limitations: SQLGlot parsing/transpilation does not prove semantic equivalence.

capabilities.name: duckdb-query-option
capabilities.target_scope: Explicit approved DuckDB query routes over shared committed data
limitations: No silent exception fallback or independent managed-table storage.

capabilities.name: python-tasks
capabilities.target_scope: SDK submission, parameters, process execution, logs and output
limitations: Fresh process is isolation, not a malicious-code sandbox.

capabilities.name: dag-lifecycle
capabilities.target_scope: Dependencies, persisted attempts, errors, cancellation and selected retries
limitations: External Python side effects are not automatically idempotent.

capabilities.name: advanced-control
capabilities.target_scope: Conditional tasks, repair runs, schedules and expanded orchestration
limitations: Each task/control type requires its own contract.

capabilities.name: workspace-dbfs-volumes
capabilities.target_scope: Declared local file namespace mappings and client operations
limitations: DBFS/volumes/raw storage are distinct; unsupported mounts/cloud URIs rejected.

capabilities.name: pyspark-import-facade
capabilities.target_scope: Supported imports scoped to a BrickHouse child worker
limitations: No global module replacement; not Spark Connect.

capabilities.name: delta-import-facade
capabilities.target_scope: Supported DeltaTable API subset backed by native table service
limitations: Not the delta-spark runtime or complete API.

capabilities.name: fs-widgets-secrets
capabilities.target_scope: Real local files, widget/parameter context and scoped secret access
limitations: No direct reuse of SDK methods that assume cluster execution.

capabilities.name: task-values-notebooks
capabilities.target_scope: Run/attempt-scoped task values and child notebook results
limitations: Missing methods must raise; debug defaults do not count as implementation.

capabilities.name: python-execution
capabilities.target_scope: Optional ipynb and declared Databricks source formats/magics
limitations: Scala/R and arbitrary shell/package magics are outside initial subset.

capabilities.name: databricks-sdk
capabilities.target_scope: Selected real SDK catalog/SQL/jobs/files workflows
limitations: Exact package version and requests required; no broad SDK claim.
Personal-account captures establish reference behavior only; support requires the pinned SDK to pass local BrickHouse tests against those observations.

capabilities.name: cli-terraform-bundles
capabilities.target_scope: Selected deployment and resource lifecycle workflows
limitations: CLI/bundle/Terraform versions and resources tracked independently.

capabilities.name: sql-connector-rest
capabilities.target_scope: Selected SQL connector REST/kernel mode
limitations: Transport option documented upstream; local interoperability remains unproven.

capabilities.name: sql-connector-thrift
capabilities.target_scope: Native Thrift SQL/session/metadata subset
limitations: Separate from REST Statement API.

capabilities.name: spark-connect
capabilities.target_scope: Native gRPC service for pinned pure Python Spark client
limitations: Must implement actual protocol/plan behavior; import facade is insufficient.

capabilities.name: cluster-warehouse-metadata
capabilities.target_scope: Local API lifecycle records for selected compute resources
limitations: Intended eventual state is simulated; never imply cloud compute exists.

capabilities.name: tracking-registry
capabilities.target_scope: Actual MLflow tracking/artifacts/selected registry mappings
limitations: UC model names, aliases and permissions have independent fixtures.

capabilities.name: python-serving
capabilities.target_scope: Real local Python model serving via selected API routes
limitations: Spark flavors and remote models excluded from native local profile.

capabilities.name: feature-engineering
capabilities.target_scope: Temporal feature joins, lineage and model feature lookup
limitations: Ordinary table registration alone is insufficient.

capabilities.name: mllib-subset
capabilities.target_scope: Native selected estimator/pipeline compatibility
limitations: Research frontier; no JVM serialization or arbitrary Java models promised.

capabilities.name: dbt-local
capabilities.target_scope: Actual dbt-duckdb project on shared table storage
limitations: Separate from dbt-databricks protocol/macro compatibility.

capabilities.name: index-lifecycle-query
capabilities.target_scope: Native persistent vector index and Databricks-facing adapter
limitations: Direct access, Delta sync, scoring/filtering and embeddings tracked separately.

capabilities.name: identity-grants-audit
capabilities.target_scope: Selected local identities, grants, ownership and audit checks
limitations: Trusted host code can bypass service controls; no multi-tenant security claim.

capabilities.name: fine-grained-policy
capabilities.target_scope: Selected row filters, column masks, lineage and system tables
limitations: Needs separate propagation rules through every data access surface.

capabilities.name: bounded-batches
capabilities.target_scope: Bounded Sparkless transforms with real sink commits
limitations: No claim of complete Structured Streaming.

capabilities.name: checkpoint-replay
capabilities.target_scope: Durable offsets, query leases, sink reconciliation and recovery
limitations: Guarantees specific to source/sink and external side effects.

capabilities.name: file-autoloader
capabilities.target_scope: Local durable file discovery and selected cloudFiles behavior
limitations: Polling is not cloud notification parity.

capabilities.name: declarative-batch
capabilities.target_scope: Selected Lakeflow/DLT definitions, DAG and refresh behavior
limitations: Different from dltHub ingestion; cross-table atomicity not implied.

capabilities.name: expectations-cdc
capabilities.target_scope: Expectation actions and selected CDC/SCD transformations
limitations: Explicit sequence/delete/late-event semantics needed.

capabilities.name: stateful-operators
capabilities.target_scope: Selected windows, watermarks, deduplication or joins
limitations: Provider API resemblance is not semantic/recovery evidence.

capabilities.name: delta-sharing
capabilities.target_scope: Native server and real independent client snapshot workflow
limitations: Protocol versions, auth, file access and Delta features must be bounded.

capabilities.name: cloud-emulators
capabilities.target_scope: Optional native reader tests against Moto/Azurite services
limitations: No automatic ADLS Gen2 parity; optional services are not base requirements.

capabilities.name: remaining-products
capabilities.target_scope: Dashboards, Genie, Lakebase, account/admin and remaining APIs
limitations: Explicit frontier requiring native feasibility and scoped contracts.

capabilities.name: jvm-distributed-frontier
capabilities.target_scope: Scala/JAR code, Spark internals, Photon and distributed behavior
limitations: Known architectural frontier; public compatibility must explicitly disclose exclusions.
